decision.rss_growth_statistic: median incremental peak RSS at 1200 minus median incremental peak RSS at 240
decision.lifetime_requirement: independent live bitmap evidence must show no linear accumulation; report observations without asserting a bound in the test
decision.control_sensitivity: retained control must visibly grow with frame count; otherwise inconclusive
decision.imageio_linear_retention: AC4 fails even if application arrays were removed
decision.wall_time: secondary paired evidence; no speed claim from a single run

provider_fixture.format: immutable fresh RGBA8 premultiplied-last sRGB bitmap for each frame
limitations: Provider callbacks observe original payload lifetimes, not internal ImageIO copies.
Fixed bitmap fixture is an ownership probe, not a renderer timing comparison.
Test-process RSS across six cases is not an independent benchmark RSS sample.

additional_evidence: Instruments Allocations/VM Tracker at 240 and 1200 frames in both modes, if provider/RSS evidence does not resolve backing-store behavior.
Long synthetic source through actual convertGIF and VideoLab, including target-FPS and max-frames; source generation excluded from measurement; verify output metadata before accepting RSS trace.
required_capture_metadata: git base and dirty source hashes
raw export unit labels and values

unreproduced_failure_paths.imageio_finalize_false: Inspected but not injected. No global limits, full volumes or interposition. Count guards are separate evidence.
unreproduced_failure_paths.midstream_corrupt_lzw: Not claimed; real decoder malformed-source rejection (cannotOpenSource or noFrames) is covered.
